title: Skill Catalog Sync
description: Mirror the steer-skill catalog from prompt-manager. Records skill id, current version, and content hash. Refresh on demand; expose drift since last sync.

requirements.title: prompt-manager API client
requirements.description: Read-only client (Connect-RPC if exposed, otherwise CLI shell-out) that lists steer skills with version + content hash. Filters out non-steer skills (workflow skills like plan-skill-discovery, idea-workshop, deployment-coordinator, skill-authoring).

validation.notes: REST adapter lists skills with version + content hash from prompt-manager /skills/sync.

requirements.title: Skill catalog snapshot storage + drift surface
requirements.description: SQLite-backed snapshot under api/internal/skillcatalog. Compare current sync against previous snapshot; expose 'changed since last sync' list for downstream staleness derivation (OT-P0-007).

validation.notes: Snapshot rows upsert idempotently into SQLite.
